{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Degarian II''''' was one of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Crote (Human)|Crote's]] fastest [[Starship/Legends|starships]]; used in the years leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. From [[Frego]], Crote allowed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to take the ship to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while escorting [[Lena Cobral]] there so she could testify against the [[Cobral family]]. Wary of an attack, the Jedi opted to find a different means of passage back to the capital. When the Jedi arrived on Coruscant, they learned that the ''Degarian II'' had been attacked and destroyed while en route; there were no survivors.
